title: Annual Global Temperature Anomalies from 1960-2025 Relative to 1950-1980
description: A data visualization for a climate-based group project that I created using data from (https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.STA:CCI). Its purpose is to demonstrate the global warming trend from the 20th-21st century using the 20th century as a baseline.

title: Atmospheric CO2 Concentration (1960-2025)
description: A data visualization for an environmental group project that I made using data from (https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.STA:CCI). I wanted to show the fluctuating yet steadily increasing CO2 levels in the atmosphere, which damages the ozone layer.

title: Percentage of Food Processing Classes by Store
description: A quadruple bar chart I created for a small project, using data from (https://dsc106.com/projects/project1/#data-grocery-store-foods). Here, I highlight the distribution of processed foods in 3 major retail stores.

title: Rating Distribution: Missing vs Not Missing Review Text
description: A distribution chart I made to observe the proportion of missing reviews compared to not missing reviews, with metadata from (https://dsc80.com/proj04/google_review_desc/). The dataset contains reviews for Hawaiian businesses.

title: Average Rating vs Number of Reviews
description: A scatterplot I designed using metadata from (https://dsc80.com/proj04/google_review_desc/). It captures the average ratings of Hawaiian businesses relative to the number of reviews for each business.

title: Ratings by Top Business Categories
description: Multiple boxplots I construed using metadata from (https://dsc80.com/proj04/google_review_desc/). It displays the rating range of top business categories in Hawaii.

title: Top 10 Business Categories by Number of Reviews
description: A horizontal bar chart I designed using metadata from (https://dsc80.com/proj04/google_review_desc/). It shows the count of reviews for the top business categories in Hawaii.

title: Distribution of Review Ratings
description: A distribution histogram I designed using metadata from (https://dsc80.com/proj04/google_review_desc/). Based on Hawaiian business reviews, it shows the counts of reviews for each star rating (1-5).

title: Distribution of Beverage Benefits by Ranking
description: A triple pie chart I created using data I collected from my workplace in 2025 (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dcvXDqluSD6pcG53NBeBvZxrs9hieD1C-4l4wSCOj8Q/edit?usp=sharing). It shows the categorical breakdown of primary benefits, secondary benefits, and tertiary benefits from the most popular beverages consumed in this sample.

title: Distribution of Favorite Beverage Types
description: A donut chart I created using data I collected from my workplace in 2025 (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dcvXDqluSD6pcG53NBeBvZxrs9hieD1C-4l4wSCOj8Q/edit?usp=sharing). Using the most popular beverages from this sample, it shows the percentage of each type of beverage consumed as classified by Pressed Juicery (e.g. Wellness Smoothie or Probiotic Lemonade).

title: Favorite Pressed Juicery Beverages
description: A large horizontal bar graph I created using data I collected from my workplace in 2025 (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dcvXDqluSD6pcG53NBeBvZxrs9hieD1C-4l4wSCOj8Q/edit?usp=sharing). Its purpose is to illustrate the most popular beverages sold from Pressed Juicery.

title: Overall Rating in Relation to the Meat:Filling Ratio of a Burrito
description: A simple line chart I worked on in a group project for COGS 9, with data from (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/18HkrklYz1bKpDLeL-kaMrGjAhUM6LeJMIACwEljCgaw/edit?usp=sharing). It establishes a roughly positive, linear trend where the overall rating increases as the meat:filling ratio increases. Accounted for vegans/vegetarians during the data cleaning process.
